descriere_scurta: SI Motion brake ramp monitoring time (processor 1)
descriere: Sets the monitoring time to define the brake ramp. The rate of rise of the brake ramp depends upon p9581 (reference value) and p9583 (monitoring time).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion actual value sensing sensorless filter time (P1)
descriere: Sets the filter time for smoothing the actual value with sensorless actual value sensing.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion actual value sensing sensorless minimum current (P1)
descriere: Sets the minimum current for encoderless actual value sensing in reference to 10 mA (i.e. when 1 % = 10 mA). - The value must be increased if C01711 has occurred with message value 1042. - The value must be decreased if C01711 has occurred with message value 1041. For synchronous motors, the following condition must be fulfilled: |p0305 x p9783| >= p9588 x 1.2

descriere_scurta: SI Motion actual value sensing sensorless accel. limit (P1)
descriere: Sets the acceleration limit to filter velocity fluctuations. If this percentage value is increased, when accelerating, velocity peaks that do not reflect the real velocity charac- teristic can occur. If this value is decreased, and this dampens the velocity peaks when accelerating. - The value must be increased if C01711 with message value 1043 has occurred. - The value must be lowered if acceleration procedures have led to an excessive Safety actual velocity.

descriere_scurta: SI forced checking procedure remaining time
descriere: Displays the time remaining before dynamization and testing of the safety shutdown paths (forced checking proce- dure).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion: Test stop signal source
descriere: Sets the signal source for the test stop of the safety-relevant motion monitoring functions.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion diagnostics pos. act. val. motor side (processor 1) /
descriere: Displays the actual motor-side position actual value for the motion monitoring functions on processor 1.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion crosswise comparison clock cycle
descriere: Displays the crosswise comparison clock cycle. The value indicates the clock cycle time with which each individual CDC value is compared between the two moni- toring channels.

Index 0: Displays the safe velocity resolution (load side). Setpoints for velocity limits or parameter changes for velocities below this threshold have no effect. Index 1: Displays the safe velocity accuracy based on the safe encoder accuracy Index: [0] = Display of the actual velocity resolution [1] = Display of the minimum velocity resolution
Displays the checksum for the Safety Integrated parameters checked using checksums on processor 1 (actual checksum).
Displays the status when the firmware is checked when the system is booted. 0: Firmware not yet checked. 1: Check running. 2: Check successfully completed. 3: Check indicates an error.
Only for service purposes.

Displays the temperatures in the power unit. Displays the effective Command Data Set (CDS).
Displays the effective Drive Data Set (DDS).
Display and connector output for status word 1.
Display and BICO output for status word 2.
Displays control word 1.
Displays supplementary control word.
Displays actual absolute current. Index: [0] = Unsmoothed [1] = Smoothed with p0045
Displays the measured actual phase currents as peak value. Index: [0] = Phase U [1] = Phase V [2] = Phase W [3] = Phase U offset [4] = Phase V offset [5] = Phase W offset [6] = Total U, V, W
Display and connector output for actual torque value. Index: [0] = Unsmoothed [1] = Smoothed with p0045
Displays the instantaneous active power. Index: [0] = Unsmoothed [1] = Smoothed with p0045 [2] = Electric power
Displays the flux actual value. Index: [0] = Unsmoothed [1] = Smoothed
Displays the actual phase voltage. Index: [0] = Phase U [1] = Phase V [2] = Phase W
Identification of the Control Unit using an LED.
Configuration of the motor when commissioning the motor.

Freely assignable name for a drive object. In the commissioning software, this name cannot be entered using the expert list, but is specified in the configura- tion assistant. The object name can be subsequently modified in the Project Navigator using standard Windows resources.
Displays the unique code number of the power unit.
Sets the actual code number from r0200 to acknowledge the power unit being used. When commissioned for the first time, the code number is automatically transferred from r0200 into p0201.
Displays the type of power unit found.
Displays the properties supported by the power unit hardware.

Displays the rated power unit power for various load duty cycles. Index: [0] = Rated value [1] = Load duty cycle with low overload [2] = Load duty cycle with high overload [3] = Reserved [4] = Reserved

The parameter is used to select a motor from a motor parameter list. When changing the code number (with the exception to the value 0), all of the motor parameters are pre-assigned from the internally available parameter lists.
Sets the rated motor voltage (rating plate).
Sets the rated motor current (rating plate).
Sets the rated motor power (rating plate).
Sets the rated motor power factor (cos phi, rating plate). For a parameter value of 0.000, the power factor is internally calculated and displayed in r0332.
Sets the rated motor efficiency (rating plate). For a parameter value of 0.0, the power factor is internally calculated and displayed in r0332.
Sets the rated motor torque (rating plate).

descriere_scurta: Motor pole pair number, actual (or calculated)
descriere: Displays the number of motor pole pairs. The value is used for internal calculations.
Sets the motor pole pair number.
Sets the torque constant of the synchronous motor.
Sets the stall current for synchronous motors (p0300 = 2xx).
Sets the maximum motor speed.
Sets the maximum permissible motor current (e.g. de-magnetizing current for synchronous motors).

descriere_scurta: Motor pole position identification current 1st phase
descriere: Sets the current for the 1st phase of the two-stage technique for pole position identification routine. The current of the 2nd phase is set in p0329. The two-stage technique is selected with p1980 = 4.
Sets the optimum load angle for synchronous motors with reluctance torque. The load angle is measured at the rated motor current.
Sets the reluctance torque constant for synchronous motors with reluctance torque (e.g. 1FE ... motors). This parameter has no significance for induction motors.
Sets the current for the pole position identification routine (p1980 = 1). For a two-stage technique (p1980 = 4) , the current is set for the 2nd phase. The current for the 1st phase is set in p0325.
Displays the rated motor slip.

Induction motor: Displays the rated magnetizing current from p0320. For p0320 = 0, the internally calculated magnetizing current is displayed. Synchronous motor: Displays the rated short-circuit current from p0320.

Displays the rated power factor for induction motors. For IEC motors, the following applies (p0100 = 0): For p0308 = 0, the internally-calculated power factor is displayed. For p0308 > 0, this value is displayed. For NEMA motors, the following applies (p0100 = 1): For p0309 = 0, the internally-calculated power factor is displayed. For p0309 > 0, this value is converted into the power factor and displayed.
Displays the rated motor torque.
Displays the torque constant of the synchronous motor used.
Sets the motor cooling system used.
Displays the rated EMF of the motor.
Setting to automatically calculate motor parameters and U/f open-loop and closed-loop control parameters from the rating plate data.
Displays the identified rated motor current.
Displays the rated motor starting time. This time corresponds to the time from standstill up to reaching the motor rated speed and the acceleration with motor rated torque (r0333).
Sets the excitation build-up time of the motor. This involves the delay time between enabling the pulses and enabling the ramp-function generator. The induction motor is magnetized during this time.
Sets the de-magnetizing time (for induction motors) after the inverter pulses have been canceled. The inverter pulses cannot be switched in (enabled) within this delay time.
Sets the stator resistance of the motor at ambient temperature p0625 (phase value).
Resistance of the power cable between the power unit and motor.

Sets the rotor/secondary section resistance of the motor at the ambient temperature p0625. This parameter value is automatically calculated using the motor model (p0340 = 1, 2) or using the motor data iden- tification routine (p1910).

Induction machine: sets the stator leakage inductance of the motor. Synchronous motor: Sets the stator quadrature axis inductance of the motor. This parameter value is automatically calculated using the motor model (p0340 = 1, 2) or using the motor identifica- tion routine (p1910).

Sets the stator direct-axis inductance of the synchronous motor. This parameter value is automatically calculated using the motor model (p0340 = 1, 2) or using the motor identifica- tion routine (p1910).
Sets the rotor/secondary section leakage inductance of the motor. The value is automatically calculated using the motor model (p0340 = 1, 2) or using the motor identification routine (p1910).
Sets the magnetizing inductance of the motor. This parameter value is automatically calculated using the motor model (p0340 = 1, 2) or using the motor identifica- tion routine (p1910).

The saturation characteristics (flux as a function of the magnetizing current) is defined using 4 points. This parameter specifies the y coordinate (flux) for the 1st value pair of the characteristic. Sets the first flux value of the saturation characteristic as a [%] referred to the rated motor flux (100 %).

The saturation characteristics (flux as a function of the magnetizing current) is defined using 4 points. This parameter specifies the y coordinate (flux) for the 2nd value pair of the characteristic. Sets the second flux value of the saturation characteristic as a [%] referred to the rated motor flux (100 %).

The saturation characteristics (flux as a function of the magnetizing current) is defined using 4 points. This parameter specifies the x coordinate (magnetizing current) for the 1st value pair of the characteristic. Sets the first magnetization current of the saturation characteristic in [%] with reference to the rated magnetization current (r0331).
Displays the total cable resistance between power unit and motor, as well as the internal converter resistance.
Displays the rated motor stator resistance at rated temperature (total of p0625 and p0627).
Displays the motor rotor resistance at an ambient temperature p0625.
Displays the nominal rotor resistance of the motor at the rated temperature. The value is the sum of p0625 and p0628.
Displays the stator leakage inductance of the motor including the motor reactor (p0233).
Displays the stator longitudinal inductance of the synchronous motor including the motor reactor (p0233).
Displays the magnetizing inductance of the motor.
Displays the stator leakage time constant.
Displays the actual stator resistance (phase value). The parameter value also contains the temperature-independent cable resistance.
Displays the actual rotor resistance (phase value). The parameter is affected by the motor temperature model.

descriere_scurta: Absolute encoder linear measuring step resolution
descriere: Sets the resolution of the absolute position for a linear absolute encoder.

descriere_scurta: and p1803 are only changed, in all cases, if a sine-wave output filter (p0230 = 3, 4) has not been selected.
descriere: Sets the actual system of units.
Sets the sensor type for the motor temperature monitoring.

Sets the alarm threshold for monitoring the motor temperature for motor temperature model 2 or KTY. After the alarm threshold is exceeded, alarm A07910 is output and timer (p0606) is started. If the delay time has expired and the alarm threshold has, in the meantime, not been fallen below, then fault F07011 is output.

Sets the threshold for monitoring the motor temperature for motor temperature model 1/2 or KTY. Motor temperature model 1 (p0612.0 = 1): alarm threshold - Alarm A07012 is output after the alarm threshold is exceeded. Motor temperature model 2 (p0612.1 = 1) or KTY: fault threshold - Fault F07011 is output after the fault threshold is exceeded.

Sets the timer for monitoring the motor temperature for motor temperature model 2 or KTY. This timer is started when the temperature alarm threshold (p0604) is exceeded. If the timer has expired and the alarm threshold has, in the meantime, not been fallen below, then fault F07011 is output.

Sets the timer between the output of alarm and fault for a temperature sensor fault. If there is a sensor fault, this timer is started. If the sensor fault is still present after the timer has expired, a corresponding fault is output.

descriere_scurta: I2t motor model thermal time constant
descriere: Sets the winding time constant. The time constant specifies the warm-up time of the cold stator winding when loaded with the motor standstill cur- rent (rated motor current, if the motor standstill current is not parameterized) up until a temperature rise of 63 % of the continuously permissible winding temperature has been reached.
Setting to activate the motor temperature model.

Sets the reduction factor for the overtemperature of the thermal adaptation of the stator/rotor resistance. The value is a starting value when switching on. Internally, after switch-on, the reduction factor has no effect corre- sponding to the thermal time constant.

Selects the identification of the stator resistance after booting the Control Unit (only for vector control). The identification is used to measure the actual stator resistance and from the ratio of the result of motor data iden- tification (p0350) to the matching ambient temperature (p0625) the actual mean temperature of the stator winding is calculated. The result is used to initialize the thermal motor model.
Defines the rated overtemperature of the stator core referred to the ambient temperature.
Defines the rated overtemperature of the stator winding referred to the ambient temperature.
Defines the rated overtemperature of the squirrel cage rotor referred to ambient temperature.
Displays the ambient temperature of the motor temperature model.
Displays the stator core temperature of the motor temperature model.
Displays the stator winding temperature of the motor temperature model.
Displays the rotor temperature of the motor temperature model.
